newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH GOVT APPROVES DM 50 MLN PRAGUE BARRACKS SALE.
newsitem.headline: CZECH GOVT APPROVES DM 50 MLN PRAGUE BARRACKS SALE.

text.p: The Czech cabinet on Wednesday approved a sale of military barracks in central Prague to European Property Development company for 50 million marks, Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said.
Speaking at a news conference after a regular government meeting, Klaus said the government also approved a payment structure of the deal, but did not give more details.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
